question.text: When <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>NPN</mi></math> transistor is used as an amplifier

options.text: electrons move from base to collector
holes move from emitter to base
electrons move from collector to base
holes move from base to collector

solution.text: Elelctrons of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mtext>n</mtext></math>-type emitter moves from emitter to base and then base to the collector when <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mtext>NPN</mtext></math> transistor is used as an amplifier.
